scope.selection: Bounded follow-up of high-value records from the prior public research: suspected closures, address changes, malformed imported addresses, and records carrying the shared directory email info@zzz.sk.
scope.importantRule: A directory-owned email, an absent search result, or an inactive directory profile is not evidence that a provider or workplace closed.

records.name: Gynekologicko-pôrodnícka ambulancia MUDr. Mária Mihálová s.r.o.

verifiedWorkplace.officialName: Primárna gynekologicko-pôrodnícka ambulancia, MUDr. Mária Mihálová, Bojnice

evidence: The e-VÚC provider page ties MUDr. Mária Mihálová to ID ZZ 63-36684279-A0001 and the exact Mission address Janka Kráľa 15, 97201 Bojnice.
The same official row explicitly states that this workplace was cancelled on 31.08.2024.
This verifies closure of the identified ambulatory workplace. It does not by itself prove dissolution or closure of the legal provider TMM SLOVAKIA s.r.o.

recommendedSafeAction.clinic: After human confirmation, mark this exact clinic workplace inactive and retain the official closure date and ID ZZ in audit history.
recommendedSafeAction.email: Remove or quarantine info@zzz.sk as a non-provider directory email.
recommendedSafeAction.doNot: Do not infer that the provider company closed, and do not apply this closure to another clinic at the same building.

records.name: Gynekologická ambulancia ProCare
evidence: The official provider listing identifies a gynecology workplace for MUDr. Peter Hrúzik at Jelačičova 17983/7 under ID ZZ 61-35875704-A0015 and marks that specific workplace closed on 31.12.2024.
The same official listing also shows a current primary gynecology workplace for MUDr. Peter Hrúzik at the same address under a different ID ZZ, 51-35875704-A0032.
The Mission record has no ID ZZ, so it cannot safely be assigned to the historical closed workplace rather than the current successor.

recommendedSafeAction.clinic: Keep active pending ID resolution. Ask an operator to map the record to current ID ZZ 51-35875704-A0032 or archive it only if internal provenance proves it represents historical ID ZZ 61-35875704-A0015.
recommendedSafeAction.email: Remove or quarantine info@zzz.sk as a non-provider directory email and obtain a provider-owned contact.
recommendedSafeAction.doNot: Do not deactivate the Mission record merely because one same-address predecessor ID closed.

globalRecommendations: Treat info@zzz.sk as imported directory contact contamination, not as a clinic-owned mailbox. Quarantine it from outreach and seek an official provider contact.
Only the exact Mária Mihálová workplace is safe to queue for inactivation from this follow-up.
For Peter Hrúzik/ProCare, resolve the Mission record to an ID ZZ before any status change because an old workplace ID closed while a successor ID at the same address remains listed.
Preserve the distinction between closure of a particular workplace permit and closure of the provider/legal entity.
